en.title: Minimize Computation Time
en.description:
In one operation, all values currently equal to some even number c are halved at the same time. Find the minimum number of operations needed to make every value odd.

The standard input/output conventions and constraints added by this site are described under "Input".
en.input: n≤200000, positive integer values ≤10^9 (added by this site).
en.explanation: Operate only once on each distinct current even value, since all elements at the same value level transform together.
hints: Operate only once on each distinct current even value, since all elements at the same value level transform together.
